deadline.value: Apply by January 15 for full funding consideration; late applications are accepted until April 30 if places remain. Year inferred.

also.quote: Applicants are still able to submit an online application after the deadline and up to April 30th.

gre_subject.value: Not mentioned on the department's application page.

supervisor.value: Not needed to apply, but contact prospective supervisors: PhD admission depends on supervision and funding being available.
supervisor.quote: You are not required to secure supervision prior to submitting an application. | applicants to our doctoral program are encouraged to contact prospective supervisors since admission to our doctoral program is always contingent upon the availability of supervision and financial support

funding.value: Admission is conditional on funding being available, and Queen's guarantees full-time PhD students at least CAD 25,000 a year (2026-27). International-fee students are usually given extra funding to cover the tuition difference.
funding.quote: admission to our doctoral program is always contingent upon the availability of supervision and financial support

also.quote: For the 2026-27 academic year, our full-time PhD students will receive a guaranteed minimum funding package of $25,000 a year
Students assessed fees at the international rate are usually offered additional funding to cover the difference between the international and the domestic tuition fee.

entry_route.value: PhD applicants normally hold a master's in mathematics and/or statistics or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to our Ph.D. program will normally have a master's degree in Mathematics and/or Statistics or related field and have demonstrated research potential and clear research interests.

notes: One PhD covers pure and applied mathematics, probability and statistics.
